name: The majority voted in favour of *disagreeing* with an amendment to a [motion](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/divisions/representatives/2021-10-28/2) "*that the resumption of the debate be made an order of the day for the next day of sitting*." This means the original motion will remain unchanged. This division related to the [Electoral Legislation Amendment (Voter Integrity) Bill 2021](https://www.aph.gov.au/Parliamentary_Business/Bills_Legislation/Bills_Search_Results/Result?bId=r6811). ### Amendment text > *That all words after "That" be omitted with a view to substituting the following words:* > > *"the resumption of the debate be made an order of the day for the first sitting after 1 January 2023".*
